chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Khālid al-Barqī, from Abī al-Bakhtarī Wahb ibn Wahb al-Qurashī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, from his father عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام said: “When the deceased dies in the sea, he is given ghusl, shrouded, and perfumed with ḥanūṭ; then a stone is fastened to his feet and he is cast into the water.”

key_terms.الْمَاءِ: the water, into which the body is cast
key_terms.حُنِّطَ: was perfumed with ḥanūṭ for burial preparation
key_terms.غُسِّلَ: was given ghusl (ritual washing of the dead)

ai.seo_question: What should be done with a deceased person who dies in the sea according to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling for handling the body of a deceased person who dies at sea. It instructs that the deceased should be given ghusl, shrouded, and treated with ḥanūṭ, then weighted with a stone at the feet and committed to the water.
